body.objective: Students will be able to describe future plans.
successCriteria: I can describe my plans after high school
I can explain reasons using 因为…所以…
I can talk about careers using 想当 and 打算
body.hook: What will you do after high school? University, college, an apprenticeship, travel, work? Being able to explain your plans and reasons in Mandarin is a real skill, useful for scholarship interviews, exchange programs and conversations with Mandarin-speaking families and employers.

study.title: 我的将来
study.question: How do I talk about my future plans in Mandarin?
study.passage:
Patterns:
• 高中毕业以后，我打算… Gāozhōng bìyè yǐhòu, wǒ dǎsuan… = After graduating high school, I plan to…
• 我想当医生。Wǒ xiǎng dāng yīshēng. = I want to be a doctor.
• 因为我喜欢帮助别人，所以我想当护士。Yīnwèi wǒ xǐhuan bāngzhù biérén, suǒyǐ wǒ xiǎng dāng hùshi. = Because I like helping others, I want to be a nurse.
Careers: 医生 yīshēng (doctor), 护士 hùshi (nurse), 工程师 gōngchéngshī (engineer), 老师 lǎoshī (teacher), 律师 lǜshī (lawyer), 电脑工程师 diànnǎo gōngchéngshī (software engineer), 商人 shāngrén (businessperson), 电工 diàngōng (electrician).
Dialogue:
张老师 Zhāng lǎoshī：高中毕业以后，你打算做什么？
Gāozhōng bìyè yǐhòu, nǐ dǎsuan zuò shénme?
马克 Mǎkè：我打算上大学，学习工程。
Wǒ dǎsuan shàng dàxué, xuéxí gōngchéng.
张老师：为什么？
马克：因为我对数学和科学很感兴趣，所以我将来想当工程师。
Yīnwèi wǒ duì shùxué hé kēxué hěn gǎn xìngqù, suǒyǐ wǒ jiānglái xiǎng dāng gōngchéngshī.
张老师：会说中文对你的职业有帮助吗？
马克：有！很多公司跟中国有生意，所以会说中文的工程师有更多机会。
English support: 学习工程 = study engineering; 对…感兴趣 duì…gǎn xìngqù = be interested in…; 有帮助 = helpful; 公司 gōngsī = company; 生意 shēngyi = business; 机会 jīhuì = opportunities.
Activity: Interview three classmates: "高中毕业以后，你打算做什么？为什么？" and report one answer in Mandarin.
study.source: Original dialogue written for this lesson.
steps: Practise 打算, 想当 and 以后
Use 因为…所以… to give reasons
Read the dialogue with a partner
discussion: What does Mǎkè plan to do after high school?
Why does he want to be an engineer?
How could Mandarin help his career?
How does 对…感兴趣 work?
study.product: Write a paragraph (8–10 sentences) in characters and pinyin about your plans after high school and your future career, using 打算, 想当, 以后 and at least two 因为…所以… sentences.

examples.title: Plans
examples.problem: Say "After graduating, I plan to work."
steps: 毕业以后 + 打算 + verb
examples.answer: 毕业以后，我打算工作。Bìyè yǐhòu, wǒ dǎsuan gōngzuò.

examples.title: Career
examples.problem: Say "I want to be a teacher."
examples.answer: 我想当老师。Wǒ xiǎng dāng lǎoshī.

examples.title: Reason
examples.problem: Say "Because I like computers, I want to be a software engineer."
examples.answer: 因为我喜欢电脑，所以我想当电脑工程师。

examples.title: Interest
examples.answer: 我对美术很感兴趣。Wǒ duì měishù hěn gǎn xìngqù.

practice.q: Say "I want to be an engineer."
What does Mǎkè want to study?
Why does Mǎkè want to be an engineer?
practice.a: He is interested in math and science.

practice.q: How could Mandarin help an engineer's career?
practice.a: Many companies do business with China, creating more opportunities.

practice.q: Translate 因为我想帮助别人，所以我想当护士。
practice.a: Because I want to help others, I want to be a nurse.

practice.q: Where does 以后 go in "after graduating"?
practice.a: After the verb phrase: 毕业以后.

misconceptions: Putting 以后 before the event instead of after it
Using 是 instead of 当 for "become"
Leaving out 所以 in 因为…所以… sentences
exitTicket: Describe your plan after high school in Mandarin.
Give one reason using 因为…所以….

items.q: "I want to be a teacher" is

options: A) many companies do business with China
items.answer: A) many companies do business with China
医生, 护士, 工程师, 老师.
He plans to go to university to study engineering and become an engineer.

items.q: Write a 因为…所以… sentence about your career.
Say what you're interested in using 对…感兴趣.
Explain how Mandarin can help careers.
items.answer: Many companies trade with China, so Mandarin speakers have more opportunities.

items.q: Write a paragraph about your future plans.
Explain the word order of 毕业以后.
items.answer: 以后 follows the event it refers to.
